name: Scale-space Backprojection with Visibility Test
definition: A method to construct a scale field by weighting Laplacian of Gaussian (LoG) extrema based on their spatial influence, modulated by a visibility test to prevent scale bleeding from large features into small embedded features.
summary: Scale-space Backprojection with Visibility Test constructs a continuous scale field by interpolating Laplacian of Gaussian extrema while using a visibility test to prevent large features from incorrectly influencing smaller embedded structures.
